Operations.Name: DeleteSettingsScanner
Operations.Description: Remove the scanner images (grype/trivy) and clean up scanner database volumes for an environment

Options.Name: removeImages
Options.Description: Must be true to actually perform the removal (required)

Options.Name: scanner
Options.Description: Which scanner image to remove (grype or trivy); omit to remove both

Options.Name: env
Options.Description: Environment id whose scanner images should be removed (required) (from GET /api/environments)

Operations.Name: DeleteSettingsScannerCache
Operations.Description: Clear the vulnerability-scanner cache (local volumes/bind-mount dirs plus each remote environment's scanner volume)

Operations.Name: GetSettingsNavigation
Operations.Description: Get the effective navigation preferences (landing page, env-click target) plus the raw global and per-user values

Operations.Name: GetSettingsScanner
Operations.Description: Get the vulnerability-scanner settings for an environment, plus (unless settingsOnly) scanner availability, versions and optional update info

Options.Name: env
Options.Description: Environment id to read scanner settings for (falls back to global defaults) (from GET /api/environments)

Options.Name: checkUpdates
Options.Description: When true, also check the scanner images for available updates (slower)

Options.Name: checkNewerVersions
Options.Description: When true, also ask the registry whether a newer scanner RELEASE exists (slower)

Options.Name: settingsOnly
Options.Description: When true, return only settings + defaults and skip the Docker availability/version checks

Operations.Name: GetSettingsSemver
Operations.Description: Get the global newer-version-tag (semver) detection config

Operations.Name: GetSettingsTheme
Operations.Description: Public theme + editor display settings (used by the login page before auth)

Operations.Name: PostSettingsGeneral
Operations.Description: Update global general settings (all fields optional; only supplied keys are written)

Operations.Name: PostSettingsScanner
Operations.Description: Save the vulnerability-scanner settings for an environment

Operations.Name: PostSettingsSemver
Operations.Description: Set the global newer-version-tag (semver) detection config

Operations.Name: PutSettingsNavigation
Operations.Description: Update navigation preferences (landing page, env-click target) at global or per-user scope
